lead.title: Salvia BioElectronics implants the first US patient in RECLAIM-II, its randomized trial in refractory migraine
lead.deck: The Eindhoven company is starting a US multicenter, randomized, double-blind trial of the MySalvia system after FDA authorization: two ultra-thin implants placed under the scalp (forehead and back of the head). It is expected to enroll about 150 adults at more than 20 hospitals and clinics, scaling up a neuromodulation therapy already studied in the Netherlands, Belgium and Australia.

milestone.title: SciBase wins its first US coverage from a Blue Cross Blue Shield insurer (Highmark) for Nevisense
milestone.summary: Highmark, which with its affiliates covers more than 7 million members, will reimburse Nevisense, the skin-lesion assessment system, for adults whose dermatologist is considering a biopsy (lesion of 2–20 mm on the trunk or limbs). It is SciBase’s first positive medical policy from a BCBS organization.
milestone.why: Coverage moves use from cash pay to reimbursed care, removing a key adoption barrier; the company is continuing talks with other US payers. A case study of what a reimbursement file is worth to a European medtech targeting the US.

brefsEurope.title: NADMED, a University of Helsinki spin-out, partners with US lab Doctor's Data on its NAD test
brefsEurope.summary: The NAD Profile blood test, which measures NAD+ and NADH from a standard venous draw, will be offered to US practitioners through Doctor's Data’s CLIA lab. It is not FDA-cleared: NADMED’s assays remain research-use-only in the US.

word.definition: Measuring how a tissue resists a very weak electric current at several frequencies, to tell healthy from abnormal tissue without taking a sample.

parts.label: Frequency sweep
parts.role: reads the tissue at several depths

parts.label: Algorithm
parts.role: turns the spectrum into a score

how.t: A reading is taken on healthy skin next to the lesion.
A signal crosses the lesion across 35 frequencies and four depth settings (the Nevisense case).
An algorithm compares with the reference and outputs an atypia score, which the clinician combines with the visual exam.

word.why: VC angle: a cheap physical measurement that can avoid biopsies, but whose value depends on clinical evidence and reimbursement. In Nevisense’s pivotal study sensitivity reached 96.6% at 34.4% specificity: a decision aid, not a standalone diagnosis. The Highmark coverage shows payers eventually follow.
